# SpikeDrivenInference

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A processing paradigm where all computations, including multi-object tracking, are performed using spike-based neural dynamics rather than conventional frame-based arithmetic. Enables energy-efficient, event-driven perception suitable for in-network neuromorphic systems where continuous temporal data streams must be processed with minimal latency.
